portal: https://www.tesla.com/ownersmanual (choose model -> index-*.html locale selector -> United States / English)
notes: Tesla publishes each manual as an HTML manual AND a PDF ('Download PDF' link -> ./Owners_Manual.pdf) per vehicle generation/edition, not per model year: Model 3 2017-2023 (2017_2023_model3) and 2024+ (model3); Model Y 2020-2024 (2020_2024_modely) and 2025+ (modely); Model S 2012-2020 (2012_2020_models) and 2021+ (models); Model X 2015-2020 (2015_2020_modelx) and 2021+ (modelx). The same edition URL is therefore repeated for every model year it covers; the documents are living manuals updated with software releases (no frozen per-year PDF). Year boundaries follow Tesla's own edition labels; transition years (e.g. MY2021 Model S/X built before the refresh, MY2024 Model 3 'Highland' vs earlier, MY2025 Model Y non-Juniper variants) may need the neighbouring edition - check by build date/VIN. US edition confirmed: locale en_us under 'North America > United States > English'; spec pages give inches/mm and psi. Access: plain python/httpx requests to www.tesla.com get Akamai 'Access Denied' (bot protection, not geo-block); all checks were made from a normal browser session (no captcha, no login). PDF verification: in-page fetch with Range bytes=0-1023 -> 206 application/pdf, body %PDF. Spec-related HTML pages per edition (doc_type html_manual): Specifications (section root), Dimensions, Subsystems (motor, transmission, steering, brakes, suspension, battery), Wheels and Tires, Vehicle Loading. The manual roots state e.g. 'Model X Owner's Manual 2015-2020, Software version: 2026.32, North America'. Tesla's HTML/PDF manuals contain no 'Capacities' page as such (no engine oil); fluid data, where present, is in Subsystems/Maintenance. After ~33 quick page checks Akamai started returning 403 'Access Denied' for further pages, so some spec pages could not be re-verified (verified=false with HTTP status recorded); URLs are taken from the edition's own table of contents (all 2015-2020 Model X pages, three 2012-2020 Model S pages and five 2021+ Model X pages are in that state; top-level navigation to the manual root still worked). Warranty: tesla.com/support/vehicle-warranty links the current North America New Vehicle Limited Warranty PDFs (search shows e.g. https://www.tesla.com/sites/default/files/New_Vehicle_Limited_Warranty_North_America_en_US.pdf); not verified because of the rate limit and not model-year specific, so not listed in documents.
